overview|citizen|1|What CivicResolve does|PUBLIC|/|en|what is civicresolve;how does this work;about this app;real banking complaint authority|CivicResolve is a demonstration for submitting and tracking fictional financial complaints. An AI classifier suggests a category and triage priority; a reviewer can check its work. It does not make a binding financial or legal decision.|README.md

submit|citizen|1|Submit a complaint|PUBLIC|/submit|en|submit grievance;file complaint;how to submit;complaint form|Open Submit, describe the financial issue in 20 to 5000 characters, and send the form. Use fictional information in this demonstration. Save the one-time reference and secret shown on the receipt.|frontend/src/features/grievances/SubmitGrievancePage.tsx

details|citizen|1|What to include|PUBLIC|/submit|en|what information;what should i write;complaint details;what happened and when;narrative mention|Describe the product involved, what happened, when it happened, and what outcome you seek. Avoid including account numbers, passwords, or other private information in this demonstration.|frontend/src/features/grievances/SubmitGrievancePage.tsx

categories|citizen|1|Supported categories|PUBLIC|/submit|en|eight categories;product categories;types of complaint;financial products|The eight categories are credit reporting or other personal consumer reports, debt collection, credit card, checking or savings account, mortgage, money transfer or virtual currency or money service, vehicle loan or lease, and student loan.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

tracking|citizen|1|Track a complaint|PUBLIC|/track|en|track grievance;where is my case;reference;tracking secret|Open Track and enter your reference and one-time tracking secret. The secret is shown only at submission and should be kept private. CivicAssist never needs it. Tracking shows status and a public timeline.|docs/SECURITY.md

status|citizen|1|Complaint statuses|PUBLIC|/track|en|status;pending review;auto routed;approved;overridden;rejected|PENDING_REVIEW means a human check was requested. AUTO_ROUTED means no review trigger was raised. APPROVED confirms the routing; OVERRIDDEN means a reviewer changed category or priority; REJECTED means a reviewer rejected the complaint as invalid. These are workflow states, not legal outcomes.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/entity/GrievanceStatus.java

priority|citizen|1|Triage priority|PUBLIC|/track|en|priority;critical;high;medium;low;urgency|LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH and CRITICAL are rule-based triage suggestions. They help order work; they are not legal deadlines or guarantees of resolution.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/entity/TriagePriority.java

confidence|model|1|Classification confidence|PUBLIC|/submit|en|confidence;89 percent;probability;prediction;category score|Confidence is the classifier's uncalibrated category estimate. For example, 89% means the model favors one category; it is not an 89% chance that a complaint will be approved. A reviewer can correct the classification.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

review|citizen|1|Human review|PUBLIC|/track|en|human review;can reviewer change it;override;correct automated routing;reviewer have to follow|A reviewer can confirm routing, change the category or priority, or reject an invalid complaint. The original model prediction and reviewer action remain available to authorized reviewers for audit.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/service/GrievanceService.java

queue|reviewer|1|Reviewer queue|REVIEWER|/reviewer|en|queue;filter;search;sort;pagination|The reviewer queue lists persisted complaints with server-side searching, filtering, sorting and pagination. Status and priority filters use the backend's supported values. Reviewers can open a case to inspect details.|frontend/src/features/reviewer/ReviewerDashboardPage.tsx

margin|model|1|Top-two probability margin|REVIEWER|/reviewer/grievances|en|margin;top two;uncertainty|The margin is the gap between the two highest category estimates. A small gap indicates the model has less separation between its leading choices. It is not a calibrated measure of correctness.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

attribution|model|1|Influential words|REVIEWER|/reviewer/grievances|en|feature attribution;influential words;tf idf words;highlighted words|The serving Logistic Regression model can show which TF-IDF words or phrases pushed a category score up or down for a complaint. These are model contributions, not proof of the underlying facts.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

models|model|1|Serving and challenger models|REVIEWER|/reviewer/audit|en|bilstm;logistic regression;tf idf;challenger;serving model|The serving classifier uses TF-IDF and Logistic Regression for intake. A PyTorch bidirectional LSTM is a reviewer-only challenger for comparison; it does not replace the serving classification. Both require human judgment.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

audit|reviewer|1|Review audit history|REVIEWER|/reviewer/grievances|en|audit history;audit of changes;review decision;who changed;review actions recorded|Authorized reviewers can inspect recorded review actions. Review decisions use optimistic locking and append audit records, so changes to a case remain traceable.|docs/SECURITY.md

analytics|reviewer|1|Analytics|REVIEWER|/reviewer/analytics|en|analytics;metrics;dashboard|The analytics screen summarizes persisted complaint and review data. Counts reflect available records; unavailable measures should not be treated as measured facts.|frontend/src/features/reviewer/ExecutiveAnalyticsPage.tsx

modelaudit|model|1|Model audit|REVIEWER|/reviewer/audit|en|model audit;evaluation;f1;accuracy|The model audit screen presents stored evaluation and comparison information. Accuracy is overall correct classifications; macro F1 weighs each category equally. Historical validation results do not guarantee performance on a new complaint.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

submit_hi|citizen|1|शिकायत कैसे दर्ज करें|PUBLIC|/submit|hi|शिकायत कैसे दर्ज करें;complaint kaise submit kare;shikayat;submit kaise kare;mujhe complaint bharni hai|Submit पेज खोलें और वित्तीय समस्या 20 से 5000 अक्षरों में लिखें। इस डेमो में केवल काल्पनिक जानकारी दें। रसीद पर मिला संदर्भ और गोपनीय कोड सुरक्षित रखें।|frontend/src/features/grievances/SubmitGrievancePage.tsx

tracking_hi|citizen|1|शिकायत की स्थिति|PUBLIC|/track|hi|शिकायत ट्रैक;status kaise dekhe;track kaise kare;reference aur secret;mera case track|Track पेज पर संदर्भ संख्या और एक बार मिला गोपनीय कोड दर्ज करें। CivicAssist आपसे कोड नहीं माँगता। वहाँ शिकायत की स्थिति और सार्वजनिक समयरेखा दिखती है।|docs/SECURITY.md

confidence_hi|model|1|AI भरोसे का अर्थ|PUBLIC|/submit|hi|confidence kya hai;89 percent ka matlab;ai prediction kya hai|मॉडल का confidence किसी श्रेणी के लिए उसका अनुमान है। यह शिकायत मंजूर होने की संभावना नहीं है। अधिकृत समीक्षक वर्गीकरण बदल सकता है।|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

pending_status|citizen|1|Pending review status|PUBLIC|/track|en|pending review;PENDING_REVIEW;waiting for human review|PENDING_REVIEW means the classifier raised a trigger for a human check. It does not promise a decision by a particular date.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/entity/GrievanceStatus.java

auto_status|citizen|1|Auto routed status|PUBLIC|/track|en|auto routed;AUTO_ROUTED;automatic routing|AUTO_ROUTED means no review trigger was raised during intake. It is a routing state, not complaint approval.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/entity/GrievanceStatus.java

approved_status|citizen|1|Approved status|PUBLIC|/track|en|approved status;APPROVED status;refund;reviewer confirmed routing|APPROVED means an authorized reviewer confirmed the suggested routing. It does not mean the financial complaint was resolved in the consumer's favor.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/entity/GrievanceStatus.java

overridden_status|citizen|1|Overridden status|PUBLIC|/track|en|overridden status;OVERRIDDEN status;case say overridden|OVERRIDDEN means an authorized reviewer changed the suggested category or priority. The original prediction remains recorded.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/entity/GrievanceStatus.java

rejected_status|citizen|1|Rejected status|PUBLIC|/track|en|rejected status;REJECTED status;rejected workflow state|REJECTED means a reviewer marked the submitted complaint invalid in this demonstration. It is not a binding legal decision.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/entity/GrievanceStatus.java

secret|citizen|1|Tracking secret safety|PUBLIC|/track|en|tracking secret;lost secret;secret recovery;why secret private;lost one-time code|The one-time secret is required with the reference to view public tracking. CivicAssist never needs it. If it is lost, this demonstration cannot recover it; do not share it in chat.|docs/SECURITY.md

credit_reporting|citizen|1|Credit reporting complaints|PUBLIC|/submit|en|credit reporting category;consumer report category|Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports is one of the eight supported product categories. The serving classifier may suggest it from the complaint narrative; a reviewer can correct the label.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

debt_collection|citizen|1|Debt collection complaints|PUBLIC|/submit|en|debt collection category;debt collector complaint|Debt collection is one of the eight supported product categories. The category labels the subject of a complaint, not its outcome.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

credit_card|citizen|1|Credit card complaints|PUBLIC|/submit|en|credit card category;card charge complaint|Credit card is one of the eight supported product categories. A card-related narrative can receive this preliminary category, subject to reviewer correction.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

checking|citizen|1|Checking or savings complaints|PUBLIC|/submit|en|checking account category;savings account category|Checking or savings account is one of the eight supported product categories. It identifies a product area, not whether a complaint is valid.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

mortgage|citizen|1|Mortgage complaints|PUBLIC|/submit|en|mortgage category;home loan complaint category|Mortgage is one of the eight supported product categories. The AI label is a preliminary triage suggestion.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

money_transfer|citizen|1|Money transfer complaints|PUBLIC|/submit|en|money transfer category;virtual currency category|Money transfer, virtual currency, or money service is one supported product category. The serving model may suggest it; a reviewer can correct the category.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

vehicle_loan|citizen|1|Vehicle loan complaints|PUBLIC|/submit|en|vehicle loan category;car lease category|Vehicle loan or lease is one of the eight supported product categories. The category is used for routing, not a decision on the consumer's claim.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

student_loan|citizen|1|Student loan complaints|PUBLIC|/submit|en|student loan category;education loan category|Student loan is one of the eight supported product categories. A reviewer may change an incorrect classification.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

review_trigger|model|1|Human review triggers|REVIEWER|/reviewer/grievances|en|review threshold;human review trigger;low confidence trigger;narrow margin trigger;rules send a case|Low confidence, a narrow top-two margin, or a policy-critical rule can flag a case for human review. The trigger is a triage safeguard, not proof that the model is wrong.|frontend/src/features/reviewer/ModelAuditPage.tsx

calibration|model|1|Model calibration|REVIEWER|/reviewer/audit|en|calibration;reliability diagram;mean predicted confidence|Calibration compares predicted confidence with observed accuracy in evaluation bins. The displayed case confidence remains an uncalibrated model estimate, not an approval probability.|frontend/src/features/reviewer/ModelAuditPage.tsx

queue_search|reviewer|1|Queue search and filters|REVIEWER|/reviewer|en|search cases;filter queue;sort queue;queue pagination;search results and counts|Reviewer search, status and priority filters, sorting, pagination, and counts come from backend results. Changing a filter resets the queue to its first page.|frontend/src/features/reviewer/ReviewerDashboardPage.tsx

error_tracking|citizen|1|Tracking lookup errors|PUBLIC|/track|en|tracking not found;wrong secret;tracking error;too many tracking requests|Tracking requires both receipt details. An invalid pair returns a not-found response, and repeated attempts can be rate-limited. If the secret was lost, the demonstration cannot recover it.|docs/SECURITY.md

limitations|citizen|1|Platform limitations|PUBLIC|/|en|platform limitation;legal advice;financial advice;production ready|CivicResolve is a demonstration using fictional information. Its AI suggestions are not binding decisions or personalized legal or financial advice. A reviewer can correct classifications.|README.md

secret_hi|citizen|1|गोपनीय ट्रैकिंग कोड|PUBLIC|/track|hi|secret kho gaya;tracking secret kya hai;गोपनीय कोड|संदर्भ संख्या के साथ एक बार मिला गोपनीय कोड आवश्यक है। CivicAssist को यह कोड न बताएँ। इस डेमो में खोया कोड वापस नहीं मिल सकता।|docs/SECURITY.md

categories_hi|citizen|1|आठ शिकायत श्रेणियाँ|PUBLIC|/submit|hi|आठ श्रेणियाँ;categories kaun si hain;category kya hai|आठ श्रेणियाँ हैं: क्रेडिट रिपोर्टिंग, ऋण वसूली, क्रेडिट कार्ड, चेकिंग या बचत खाता, मॉर्गेज, धन हस्तांतरण, वाहन ऋण या लीज, और छात्र ऋण। यह प्रारंभिक वर्गीकरण है।|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

review_hi|citizen|1|मानव समीक्षा|PUBLIC|/track|hi|reviewer badal sakta hai;मानव समीक्षा;समीक्षक बदल सकता|अधिकृत समीक्षक AI की सुझाई श्रेणी या प्राथमिकता बदल सकता है। मूल अनुमान और समीक्षा कार्रवाई ऑडिट के लिए दर्ज रहते हैं।|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/service/GrievanceService.java
